name: excalidraw
description: Manage Excalidraw through the built-in Codex browser using the account selected for the current project, with optional read-only CLI/helper diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: Use the active browser account for project-specific workspaces, collections, scenes, memberships/invites, canvas editing, backups, and recovery. Management changes use visible UI controls; CLI/helper logs and status are optional read-only supplements with independently verified scope. Browser onboarding requires no API tokens.
defaultPrompt: Open Excalidraw in the built-in Codex browser and verify the account/workspace for this scene.
Inspect my Excalidraw resources without changes.
Plan a Excalidraw operation and show its target and impact.
